slides.headline:
Where did your week go?
AI can sort it.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Without a list, you can't tell what to cut or hand off.
slides.right:
List it. Sort it.
Fix one thing.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: List your week
slides.card: My tasks last week: [paste calendar, to-do list, sent emails]. Group similar ones.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Sort into 4 buckets
slides.card: Sort each task: delete, automate, delegate or keep. Give one reason per task.
slides.note: Be strict. Keep is for work only you can do.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Find the quick win
slides.card: Which 3 tasks cost the most time and are easiest to automate or hand off?
slides.note: Start with one. Not all three.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Plan the first fix
slides.card: Write a simple plan to automate [task]. Tools I already use: [list]. Max 5 steps.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Check and repeat
slides.card: Here is what I changed: [list]. What should I measure to see if it saved time?
slides.note: Time saved is a guess until you track it.

slides.headline:
Send this to someone
who's always busy.
slides.sub: AI sorts it. You decide what to cut.

scenes.title: THE AI STEP
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here are this week's newsletters. Write a digest: 5 key ideas, 3 worth reading in full (and why), 1 idea I can use this week. Skip ads and repeats. Under 200 words.

scenes.note: AI summarizes. You decide what matters.
scenes.text: Follow for Part 2: digest to action list.
